paragraphs: (Shemaya son of Bunni; the source cites Nehemiah 11:15.) R' Yehudah bar Bunni; Terumot, chapter 11, at the end of halakhah 1.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Masoretic Nehemiah 11:15 verse has the longer chain Shemaya son of Chashuv son of Azrikam son of Chashavya son of Bunni; Hyman’s supplied shorter “Shemaya son of Bunni” wording is retained as his pointer. The complete seven-paragraph Guggenheimer Terumot 11:1 selection does not attest Yehudah bar Bunni; its final paragraph instead has Yehudah ben Keini. This is only a bounded nonmatch in that selection, not absence elsewhere or a locator repair. The separate personal title remains R', and no common ancestry or identity is bound.
